store.name: Tile and Oak
store.tagline: A room set from the room itself
store.about: Your shoot keeps coming back to the terracotta floor, the open shelves and the bentwood chairs. This set carries them into a rug, a print, a pillow and a plate.

products.title: Tile Floor Entrance Rug
products.prompt: Printed entrance rug, 3x5 ft, low pile for commercial foot traffic: large hexagon tiles in terracotta with thin limewash-white grout lines and a zinc grey border, each tile at least 5 inches across. Flat printed pattern, no fringe, no text, no logo.
products.why: Terracotta floor tile is in 75% of the shoot's moments.

products.title: Stoneware Shelf Print
products.prompt: Wall art print, 18x24 in, matte paper: rows of simple cup and bowl silhouettes on open shelves, flat shapes in oak, olive and limewash white, no shading. No text, no logo.
products.why: Open shelves of stoneware show up in 58% of the moments.

products.title: Bentwood Curve Pillow
products.prompt: Printed throw pillow for banquette seating, 18x18 in: a repeat of loose bentwood chair curves in oak on limewash white with olive accents, lines at least 1 cm wide. Flat print, wipeable cover, hidden zip. No text.
products.why: Bentwood chairs are in 50% of the moments.

products.title: Morning Window Plate
products.prompt: Decorative ceramic plate, 10 in, for display only, not for food service: a tall arched window shape in limewash white on a terracotta ground with a thin zinc grey rim. No text.
products.why: Tall windows and morning light are in 33% of the moments.
